info.description:
# Endpoint

The base endpoint is `https://api.ddr.ultradns.com`, which all of the following REST routes will follow.


# Authentication

Authentication is performed using X-API-Key header with provided PSK API key on each request

# cURL Example

```curl --header "X-API-Key: <your API key>" https://api.ddr.ultradns.com```
